test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

If she had begun earlier, she might have suceeded in finishing the extremely intricate project before the deadline.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the given sentence is **"suceeded". **
 
• The correct spelling is** "succeeded".**
 
• It means** achieve the desired aim or result.**
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• She **succeeded **in convincing her boss to give her a raise.
 
• He **succeeded **in completing the marathon despite the hot weather.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "deadline" **is spelled correctly. It refers to** the final date or time by which something must be done.**
 
• **Option 2: "intricate" **is spelled correctly. It means **complex or detailed.**
 
• **Option 4: "earlier"** is spelled correctly. It means **before a certain time or event.**
